picks.name: dgoHn
picks.source_note: Planet Mu already seeded. Dropped a Pearson Sound lead after confirming the "Red Sky" EP everyone was tracking for a Nov 11 Hessle Audio release is actually from 2022 -- a year-confusion false positive carried over from a prior day's notes. Exact Bandcamp link unconfirmable via search, but Planet Mu's own release page explicitly links out to a Bandcamp purchase option.
picks.bio: "Tessares" (June 26, 2026, Planet Mu) is dgoHn's (John Cunnane) fourth album and first for the label -- playful, unconventional drum & bass that contrasts sparse, melodic passages with complex drumfunk and breakcore programming.
picks.why_listen: Technically dense but playful drum & bass -- good for a faster, more rhythmically intricate stretch of a set that wants to avoid straightforward jungle tropes.
